source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.26
text: A second top-dress urea (46-0-0) application, at a rate of one 50 kg sack per hectare, is recommended about 20 days after the first top-dress application, or more precisely timed to the crop's panicle-initiation stage (កំណើតកួរ / young panicle formation) — producers are told to confirm panicle initiation by dissecting a sample stem and checking for a young panicle of about 1–2 cm. The manual also describes using a leaf color chart (LCC) to help judge whether/how much urea is needed based on leaf greenness at this stage.
